title: Sarbacher tells Strieber about Battelle materials

tellings.quote: Sam gave me Sarbacher's number and then he called me back and he said Sarbacher is waiting for you to call him. He's very eager to talk to you. So I call Sarbacher. Sarbucker proceeds to tell me all kinds of detail about the materials that he was dis was working on at the Battel Memorial Institute

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author, says that in the 1980s a man named Sam gave him the phone number of Robert Sarbacher, a scientist, and told him Sarbacher was eager to talk. Strieber says that when he called, Sarbacher told him in detail about materials he had been working on at the Battelle Memorial Institute, a research institute. Strieber tells it because, as he presents it, it would mean a scientist spoke first-hand about studying unusual materials.
